subject: general
question: As per the UN's 'World Cities Report 2016', India is expected to have ______ megacities by 2030, with each of them having a population of more than 10 million.
solution:
The correct answer is **7**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **UN's 'World Cities Report 2016'** provides a comprehensive overview of urbanization trends across the world.
 
• According to the report, India is expected to have **7 megacities** by 2030.
 
• A **megacity** is defined as a city with a population of more than 10 million people.
 
• This trend indicates significant urban growth and development in India.
 
• Current megacities in India include Mumbai, Delhi, and Kolkata, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The **UN's 'World Cities Report 2016'** is a detailed examination of the state of urbanization globally, offering insights into demographic, social, economic, and environmental trends. It highlights the challenges and opportunities associated with rapid urban growth, particularly in developing countries.
